sources.title: Scripps Layoffs Continue With 431 Cuts as CEO Promises 100 New Jobs in 'Enterprise-Wide Transformation'
sources.description: More layoffs are underway at Scripps, with the company revealing Tuesday it would eliminate 431 positions while adding 100 new jobs as part of an "enterprise-wide transformation."

sources.title: Scripps says layoffs done for now, touts higher political ad forecast | TheDesk.net
sources.description: The higher political ad forecast projection comes one day after Scripps eliminated 430 positions across the company.
